recognize_zh: 腹部皮膚照片中，毛髮呈捲曲螺旋狀（corkscrew hairs），許多毛囊周圍有細小紅色出血點（perifollicular hemorrhages），部分毛囊角化凸起，這是壞血病（維生素 C 缺乏）的典型皮膚表現。
features: Coiled, corkscrew-shaped body hairs across the abdominal skin
Small red perifollicular hemorrhages centered on hair follicles
Follicular hyperkeratotic papules with dark keratin plugs
Distribution is diffuse and follicle-based rather than random petechiae
No large ecchymoses or palpable purpura in this field
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the abdominal skin shows numerous coiled, corkscrew-like hairs with small red hemorrhages centered on hair follicles and follicular hyperkeratotic plugs. The hemorrhages are perifollicular rather than randomly distributed, and there is no palpable purpura. This is a clinical image without microscopic morphology; the combination of corkscrew hairs and perifollicular hemorrhage is characteristic of scurvy (vitamin C deficiency), typically with normal platelet count and coagulation studies.

ddx.vs: Petechiae are not centered on follicles, hairs are normal, and the platelet count is low.
Produces palpable purpura, usually on dependent lower extremities, without corkscrew hairs or follicular keratotic plugs.
Shows follicular papules or pustules without hemorrhage and without corkscrew hair shafts.
